name: KrishnaDas Delivery Date for WooCommerce
author: krishnadas8119

sections.description:
KrishnaDas Delivery Date for WooCommerce allows customers to choose their preferred delivery date during WooCommerce checkout.

The plugin helps store owners manage scheduled deliveries with configurable delivery settings including:

  • Minimum delivery days
  • Maximum delivery days
  • Disabled weekdays
  • Blocked holiday dates
  • Custom delivery date label

Perfect for grocery stores, local delivery businesses, cake shops, pharmacies, and Indian WooCommerce stores offering scheduled delivery services.

Features

  • Delivery date field on WooCommerce checkout
  • Customer preferred delivery date selection
  • Minimum and maximum delivery day limits
  • Disable specific weekdays
  • Block holiday delivery dates
  • Custom delivery date label
  • Delivery date validation
  • Display delivery date in:
    • Admin order page
    • Customer order details
    • WooCommerce emails
  • HPOS compatible
  • Lightweight and easy to configure
  • Translation ready
  • WordPress coding standards followed

Documentation

Plugin Website:
https://hmsmanager.com/krishnadas-delivery-date-for-woocommerce/

Visit the plugin website for setup instructions, screenshots, FAQs, and support resources.

Security

The plugin follows WordPress security best practices.

  • Data sanitization
  • Output escaping
  • Nonce verification
  • Direct access protection
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Delivery Date
  4. Configure delivery settings
  5. Save settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Block?

Currently, the plugin supports WooCommerce Classic Checkout only.

Can I disable weekend deliveries?

Yes. You can disable specific weekdays from plugin settings.
